subject.title: Alibaba Token Plan: personal (Solo) subscriptions render no quota rows — ProductCode is hardcoded to the Teams plan

question: Should CodexBar explicitly extend the Alibaba Token Plan provider to Personal/Solo subscriptions, using a dedicated Personal API path rather than retaining Team-edition-only behavior?
rationale: The report confirms a meaningful unsupported subscription variant, but the correct endpoint, schema, and cross-region support boundary are not yet established; selecting that product scope is not a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor a verified Personal/Solo path
options.body: Adopt a dedicated Personal API implementation after a subscriber provides a redacted request/response capture that proves the China-mainland quota schema.

options.title: Keep Team Edition scope
options.body: Document that the current provider supports Team-edition credit-pool accounts only and defer Personal/Solo support until its API contract is stable.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a verified Personal/Solo path
recommendation.body: Adopt a dedicated Personal API implementation after a subscriber provides a redacted request/response capture that proves the China-mainland quota schema.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision determines the supported provider scope and whether to invest in a new subscription variant.
